reconstructed_markdown:
Munich has a thriving artisanal bread scene. Several standout craft bakeries specialize in long\-fermented, organic, or traditional sourdough \(Sauerteig\) breads:

- [Julius Brantner Brothandwerk](https://julius-brantner.de/) — One of Munich's most acclaimed modern artisan bakeries. They specialize in 100% organic ingredients, extended dough resting times, and natural sourdough fermentation. Signature items include their classic "Brothandwerk 25" sourdough loaf. Locations include Schwabing \(Nordendstraße\), Altstadt \(Kreuzstraße\), and Haidhausen \(Pariser Straße\). [3]
- [Brotraum](https://brotraum.bio/) — A popular organic \(bio\) artisan bakery in Schwabing known for dedicated handcrafting. They bake a fantastic range of fresh daily sourdough breads, seeded whole\-grain \(Kornbrot\), and walnut sourdough loaves alongside incredible pastries.
- [Boulangerie Dompierre](http://www.dompierre.de/) — While French\-focused \(using flour imported from a historic mill near Paris\), they are famous across Munich for their artisanal naturally leavened French country loaves \(levain\), baguettes, and rustic sourdough options. They have multiple spots around the city, including on Hans\-Sachs\-Straße in Glockenbachviertel/Isarvorstadt. [4] [5]

If you're looking for a specific neighborhood or style \(like 100% rye sourdough vs. classic wheat sourdough\), let me know and I can pinpoint the closest bakery or recommend specific loaves for you.
